topic: How does the 45° scan range affect link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users compared to broadside beams?
consensus_response: The 45° scan range introduces beamforming losses, reducing antenna gain and impacting edge-of-coverage users. This decreases signal quality and capacity, leading to increased interference and decreased network performance. Scan losses and beam squint effects further degrade user experience.
reference_context: SatCom systems face challenges in link budget calculations due to scan range limitations, affecting edge-of-coverage users.
